All 5 queued pages moved one-time from pending to done in queue.json; none were previously done and none are on the frozen list. For brampton/mississauga/calgary (shared [city]/page.tsx template), only each city's data entry was edited — the shared JSX (services grid, pricing, process, timeline sections, and its own duplicate LocalBusiness schema block) was deliberately left untouched per runbook rule 1, since editing it would touch every other city on that template regardless of queue status. That shared-template LocalBusiness/aggregateRating re-emission (src/app/locations/[city]/page.tsx) is a pre-existing schema-rule violation affecting ~19 cities — flagging for a future dedicated cleanup pass rather than fixing today, since fixing it would require a shared-JSX edit outside today's one-time-pass scope. state.json nextDay incremented 5 → 6 since the day's core work (pages + blogs) shipped cleanly with a green build both phases.
